title: An Introduction to Design Patterns in C++ with Qt 4
author: Alan Ezust, Paul Ezust
description: A full C++ course built around the Qt 4 framework, teaching modern C++, object-oriented design, and the classic Gang-of-Four design patterns through practical GUI and application examples.
